manual.title: Manual
manual.basics.title: How a match works
manual.basics.p1: Two sides play on one map. The Attacker sends expedition waves along the routes to reach the objective. The Defender watches the routes and turns the expeditions back.
manual.basics.p2: A match starts with a short preparation. Then the clock runs: the Attacker wins by holding the objective until its bar is full, the Defender wins when time runs out.
manual.basics.p3: Supplies pay for units and buildings, points pay for abilities. Both grow during the match.
manual.attacker.title: Playing the Attacker
manual.attacker.p1: Build a wave at the bottom: choose a unit, how many, a formation and a route. A wave can have up to four groups on different routes.
manual.attacker.p2: Select a group on the map or in the list to give orders: hold at the next junction, advance, reroute or retreat.
manual.attacker.p3: Scouts are fast and see far. Use Reconnaissance to look ahead before the big wave sets off.
manual.defender.title: Playing the Defender
manual.defender.p1: Choose something to build at the bottom and tap a glowing place on the map. Posts watch and turn groups back, checkpoints can hold up a route, patrols move.
manual.defender.p2: Select an asset to upgrade, repair or remove it, and to set which group it watches first.
manual.defender.p3: At least one route must always stay open. A patrol inside the objective zone stops the Attacker's bar.
manual.detection.title: Seeing and being seen
manual.detection.p1: Groups start unseen. When they come into reach of a post or patrol they are detected, and soon identified.
manual.detection.p2: Only detected groups can be targeted by the Defender's abilities.
manual.detection.p3: The Attacker sees ranger buildings once a group comes close. Remembered buildings stay on the map, a little faded.
manual.controls.title: Controls
manual.controls.p1: Mouse: drag to move the map, right-drag to turn, wheel to zoom. Click to choose, right-click or Esc to cancel.
manual.controls.p2: Touch: drag with one finger to move, pinch to zoom, two fingers to turn. Tap to choose. On phones, swipe up at the bottom for lists and orders.
manual.controls.p3: Keyboard shortcuts for single player are below; change them in the settings.

hot.sideHint.defender: Builds and gives orders with the mouse, and moves the camera.
hot.controls.attacker: Keyboard: {cursor} moves the junction cursor, 1–4 units, {routes} routes, Enter adds a group or stops a group at the cursor, {launch} launches, {pause} pauses.

hot.pausesRule: Each player may take 3 planning pauses of up to 20 seconds. Either player can end a pause early.
manual.hotseat.title: Hot-seat
manual.hotseat.p1: Two people play at one PC. The Attacker uses the keyboard and the left half of the screen; the Defender uses the mouse, the right half and the camera.
manual.hotseat.p2: The Attacker moves a junction cursor on the route map with W A S D. With a group chosen (Tab), Enter stops it at the cursor junction and T Y U change its route there.
manual.hotseat.p3: Both players see the whole map; groups the Defender has not detected carry a hidden mark and cannot be targeted. Each player has 3 planning pauses of up to 20 seconds.
